title: Great Hall
shortDescription: Six bright banners hang above tables built around living oaks.
longDescription:
Living oak columns spread into a roof of beams and leaves, holding the Great Hall like cupped hands. Long tables bear the marks of ink pots, hot mugs, and one memorable attempt to carve a perfect circle.
Banners for Ember, Thorn, Veil, Stars, Stone, and Steel stir above the lanterns. At the high table, Headmaster Alder studies an acorn-shaped tuning fork with a puzzled smile.

fixtures.name: Headmaster Alder
fixtures.lookDescription: A silver-browed stag with an ink-stained cuff and an attentive tilt to his ears. Try talk alder.
fixtures.examineDescription: Alder's green robe has been carefully patched at the elbows. An acorn tuning fork peeks from one pocket; the other appears to contain an alarming number of folded questions. He listens all the way to the end of a sentence.
fixtures.dialogue: "Welcome. I collect questions; answers are welcome too, when they have evidence." Alder holds the tuning fork by its stem. "The school has been humming below our feet. I would rather understand a mystery than frighten everyone with a guess."

fixtures.name: School Banners
fixtures.examineDescription: Ember shows a sheltered flame; Thorn, a leaf opening through a thorny branch; Veil, a silver moth; Stars, a clear constellation; Stone, a patient arch; Steel, a blade laid flat in an open hand. Beneath all six: 'Learn well. Use wisely. Leave room for others.'
